description: Declarative reproduction package for the frozen 40-call development comparison. Raw captures remain local and ignored. This package is a post-run public copy; the original protocol checksum below remains authoritative.

frozen_protocol.purpose: Paired development regression of 54 versus uncommitted 34 skill guidance; no commit authorization implied.
frozen_protocol.candidate_identity: Uncommitted working-tree snapshot; inventory hash is authoritative, not a candidate commit.
frozen_protocol.host: Codex CLI 0.163.0-alpha.10.2; ephemeral; same local capabilities; exec ignores user config; global skills/features disabled via per-run options; no external providers
frozen_protocol.model: gpt-6.1-sol; medium; requested service_tier=default; fast/ultrafast disabled; effective backend tier not independently exposed
frozen_protocol.selection: Full catalog (54 versus 34), not core preset. Fresh context and separate complete fixture for every call.
frozen_protocol.sandbox: read-only for analysis; workspace-write for authorized executable cases. No approval escalation.
frozen_protocol.grading: Frozen rubrics; actual visible commands/artifacts and code oracles; failed/timeouts retained. Lead review, no independent or heldout claim. Routing diagnostics separate from outcome. Zero tolerated observed candidate-only critical failures; any failure prevents blanket no-regression claim.
frozen_protocol.task_wrapper: Read AGENTS.md and work inside this checkout. Use the installed guidance naturally. Return the requested result; do not inspect library metadata or sources unrelated to the task.
frozen_protocol.forbidden: No network/browser, installs, global changes, commits, pushes, deployment, messaging, delegation or controller/other-trial access.
frozen_protocol.readiness: Unscored exact-host/model workspace write and Python execution passed; no skills advertised without local registrations. Oracle controls reject known defects and accept independent corrections.

host_options_template: skills.config=[{path="<each advertised global SKILL.md and resolved path>",enabled=false}, ...]
environment: Use existing saved authentication in place; remove inherited CODEX_* and OPENAI_API_KEY/OPENAI_BASE_URL overrides from the child environment. Do not copy credentials or change global settings. Shell environment inherits core.
setup: Create one fresh temporary Git checkout outside any library or consuming-project ancestor for every case/repetition/condition. Initialize Git without committing.
Copy fixture_contents with exact bytes. Set .gitignore to library/, .agents/, output/, __pycache__/ and *.pyc, one entry per line with a final newline.

Place the guidance subset under library/. Register every catalog skill using .agents/skills/<name> -> ../../library/skills/<name>. Do not distribute this protocol, rubrics, captures or oracle to subjects.

Baseline subset is from the pinned commit; candidate is the uncommitted snapshot specified by the inventory. Select skills/** excluding any evals or contribution-lab path component and contribution_lab.py, plus docs/agents/**, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. No discovery/configuration from the controller is copied.

Run the exact host debug prompt-input with the host options and task prompt for every checkout. Assert the only advertised skill names are the expected catalog names, 54/34; reject global skills and library-controller ancestry. Retain receipts.

Calibrate immutable tools/check.py on original fixture. Calibrate both oracles against known-good and known-bad implementations. Run one unscored no-skill readiness probe using identical host/model settings to write/run a trivial Python assertion.
Execute once in the recorded submission order with at most two active calls; fresh ephemeral context each time; no retries in this comparison. Compose task_wrapper + two newlines + case prompt.
Capture visible JSONL events and final answer; discard reasoning event content. Record wall duration, reported usage, command argv, exits and timeout. Retain failed attempts.

Snapshot postsubject files before running independent checks. For execute cases run the separately authored oracle, immutable tools/check.py and a copy of subject final tests against original event source or supplied faulty migration. Preserve all results.

Compare fixture/guidance bytes, symlinks, sentinels and Git state; inspect visible commands and file changes for permitted scope. Lead reviews full outputs against frozen rubrics. Populate evaluator records using actual observed skills/actions and exact excerpts.

Use evaluate.py from the candidate: override SUITE to an exact JSON rendering of suite and ROOT to the baseline guidance catalog (54-name superset for observed identities). Call grade on each run then compare. Keep candidate revision as ancestry anchor, with uncommitted snapshot hash as its actual identity. Never call it a candidate commit.

cases.prompt: Fix the duplicate-registration bug in src/event_bus.py. Same topic and key must replace the old callback, not append it. Separate keys and topics remain independent; disposing an older registration must not remove its replacement; disposal is idempotent. emit takes a stable callback snapshot, so changes during an emit affect subsequent emits. Reproduce with a failing regression before the fix, repair the owner, test relevant controls and report evidence. Edit only src/event_bus.py and tests/test_*.py; do not commit.

cases.prompt: Implement migrate_batch(records, after_id=None, limit=2) in src/migration.py and focused tests. records is a list of mutable dicts with unique positive integer id. Process at most limit records in ascending id strictly above after_id (None means beginning). Return (last visited id, number converted); when none remain return (after_id, 0). limit must be a positive integer. Rows already containing sessions are authoritative: leave them entirely unchanged. For other rows, range is either null or {start: int, end: int} with start < end; convert to sessions=[] or [{start,end}], remove range, retain all other fields. Invalid legacy data raises ValueError without modifying ANY record in that batch. Resume must tolerate deletion of already processed rows; repeated completed/resumed work must not overwrite new-writer sessions. IDs are stable; do not promise production writer fencing from this in-memory helper. Edit only src/migration.py and tests/test_*.py, run checks and report remaining limits. No commit.

import unittest

from src.event_bus import EventBus


class BasicEvents(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_single_delivery_and_disposal(self):
        bus = EventBus()
        seen = []
        dispose = bus.subscribe('news', 'owner', seen.append)
        bus.emit('news', 'first')
        dispose()
        bus.emit('news', 'second')
        self.assertEqual(seen, ['first'])

    def test_topic_isolation(self):
        bus = EventBus()
        seen = []
        bus.subscribe('news', 'owner', seen.append)
        bus.emit('other', 'ignored')
        self.assertEqual(seen, [])

review_policy: Lead agent review, unblinded and not independent. Full answer context supports omission judgments. Outcome and routing are separate; do not downgrade a correct tiny edit for loading no skill. Any candidate-only failure prevents blanket no-regression claim.
